violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. A package of bread was stored on a tube of raw ground beef in the reach in cooler in the corner of the kitchen.

Thawing potentially hazardous food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not thawed in an approved manner. Packages of Chislic were being thawed in a container by the sink. This did not have running water.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. Plates and a strainer were being stored in the hand sink by the fryers.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door. The doors to the restrooms were not self closing. The spring to the women’s restroom was not connected.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Fans in kitchen in need of cleaning.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as needed. - Filters on north end of grill in need of cleaning.
